demeaned_gram_extra.discrete_floor_note: With C=4 the meaning RDM is invariant under 8 of 24 condition relabelings, so uncorrected P(lambda* >= lambda_obs) has floor 8/24 ≈ 0.333 when this partition is uniquely best. Paper Fig 7 uncorrected p<0.05 around t=400 ms is not reachable under this null without a different permutation scheme or a strict-'exceeds' rule that ignores equivalent relabelings.
demeaned_gram_extra.step_note: Sliding step is not specified in Ossadtchi et al. 2024. 25 ms is a documented choice, not a paper value.

permutation_floor_greater_equal.note: Equivalent relabelings leave D unchanged, so P(lambda* >= lambda_obs) cannot fall below the multiplicity of the observed RDM if that structure is uniquely best.

demeaned_gram_extra.note_rdm_corr: rdm_corr_window is Pearson of unique i<j entries of the theoretical RDM vs ||u_i-u_j||^2 on the analysis-window component traces (demeaned iff demean_time). rdm_corr_full_epoch uses the same spatial filter on the whole epoch. Paper face 0.82 / car >0.99 are not tuning targets.
